row.evidence: Tropic's SSO guide says 'Tropic supports SAML-based provisioning only (SCIM and JIT provisioning are not supported)' and that user creation in Tropic must be manual.
row.notes: New row. Tropic sells one platform plan, 'Starting at $3,083 per month', priced by employee count (flat, so per-user fields are null; billing period not stated). SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, OneLogin via custom SAML apps, finished by Tropic Support) is documented without a plan gate; the vendor explicitly says SCIM and JIT are not supported and users are created manually. Tropic's Okta integration only reads app-usage data from Okta and does not create Tropic users. The Tropic REST API (contracts, purchase requests, suppliers; bearer API keys; 50 requests/min) lists no user endpoints publicly; full reference needs a login.

plans.name: Tropic
plans.price_text: Starting at $3,083 per month; pricing based on employees
plans.notes: Single published plan; Intake and Orchestration and Full Service Negotiation are add-ons. SSO is documented in the help centre with no plan named.

limitations.text: SCIM and JIT provisioning are not supported; users must be created manually in Tropic.

auth.notes: Admin-generated API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks cover procurement events (purchase request task status, new contract); no user events are listed.

user_api.notes: A REST API (contracts, purchase requests, comments, suppliers) and webhooks exist with Admin-generated bearer API keys, but no user-management endpoints are listed in the public overview; the full reference sits behind the Tropic login.

okta.notes: No Tropic app in the Okta OIN (okta.com/integrations/tropic/ 404); vendor guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app. The separate Okta 'Access & Usage' integration reads Okta data into Tropic and does not provision users.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra gallery tutorial list; vendor guide uses 'Integrate any other application' (non-gallery).

google.notes: Google OAuth2 sign-in is a login option (social sign-in, not SAML); no Google Workspace SAML guide found.

onelogin.notes: Vendor guide uses OneLogin 'SAML Custom Connector (Advanced)'; OneLogin catalogue not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: No Tropic entry in JumpCloud's integration guide list; integrate-with-tropic returned 403.

fallbacks.other_sync: None into Tropic. Okta, Google, BambooHR and Workday integrations pull usage/employee data into Tropic for spend analytics, not user accounts.
